settingsPage.languageNote: Translations other than English were machine-generated and have not been reviewed by a native speaker or a lawyer; consent texts are binding in their English version.
settingsPage.imported: Imported {people} new people and {genomes} genomes from dump v{version} ({exportedAt}); people already here were left unchanged.
settingsPage.title: Settings & export
settingsPage.fullDumpIntro: Everything: people, pedigree, the original genome files, consents, health log, notes, chats, sharing log. One .hearth file; add a passphrase to encrypt it with AES-GCM. Hearth keeps no copy anywhere. Import accepts .hearth files, older .json.gz dumps and portable .html archives.
settingsPage.documentReadingIntro: Optional. Lets "Read a document" on a person's health log send a photo, scan or PDF straight from this browser to Google Gemini for transcription. The key is stored only in this browser's database and is never part of a dump. Nothing is sent until you confirm each document.
settingsPage.freeTierNotice: On Google's free tier, content you send may be used to improve their models. Use a key from a paid project if that matters to you.
settingsPage.subject: Subject
settingsPage.revokeConfirm: Revoke and delete {who}'s {what}? This cannot be undone.
settingsPage.sharingLogIntro: Every context pack copied out of Hearth, with the exact text, and every document sent to a provider with your key (file names and hashes; the file itself is not kept). Nothing else has ever left this device.
settingsPage.eraseIntro: Deletes all people, genotypes, consents, notes and logs from this browser. There is nothing to recover afterwards unless you exported a dump.
settingsPage.storageMemory: memory (not persistent in this browser context)
settingsPage.appearanceNote: System follows your device's light or dark setting; Light and Dark keep that look on this device.
